scientific_question: If the exact same formula-error report is delivered early enough, does the agent gather relevant evidence or make a traceably related workbook edit?
scope: delivery-and-timing mechanism probe; not capability confirmation or natural-workflow prevalence
task_selection_rule: eligible Debugging tasks, excluding prior discovery and reserved IDs, input <=1 MiB; ascending task ID; first four zero-model NFE >=3
selection_screen: zero-model openpyxl round-trip plus frozen detector; no agent/treatment/gold outcome, first four NFE>=3; preliminary XX_03 screen broadened before preregistration because only two positive tasks; all screening results frozen in population.json
early_save_instruction_exact: After your first substantive workbook edit, save a provisional `output.xlsx` by call 20, then continue inspecting, correcting, verifying, and completing the task normally.

mechanism.recalculation_comparison: input UNO as-is; current output UNO calculateAll, saved recalculated copy, read; unchanged from frozen runner
mechanism.trigger: first successful changed-byte output.xlsx save whose new_formula_error delta is nonempty
mechanism.clean_save: silent, later nonempty save may fire
mechanism.append: after truncation to successful save observation, zero model calls, informational, fails open
mechanism.control: same invisible detector telemetry, no report

prior_settings_mechanically_extracted.scorer: official evaluation.py after open_spreadsheet.py LibreOffice refresh

contact_definition: treatment report written and appended after first nonempty qualifying output save; TIMELY_CONTACT iff delivered at call <=25 and 50-call_cap minus delivery call >=25
primary_endpoint: TIMELY_CONTACT_RATE across four task-level treatment attempts, using permitted infrastructure replacement if primary censored
secondary_mechanistic_endpoint: TRACEABLE_EVIDENCE_USE among timely contacts: post-report evidence relevant to reported computational problem gathered via any tool and/or an actual output.xlsx edit traceably related by named cell, formula, or demonstrable dependency; generic bash calls and merely touching file do not count
capability_safety_endpoints: exploratory paired official modification and regression deltas on valid submitted pairs; no inference from unpaired, noncompletion, token use, or error disappearance alone; prior regression guard tracked (mean >=-0.01 and no task <=-0.02; harm signal mean <=-0.02 or any <=-0.05)
provisional_save_endpoint: output.xlsx changed-byte successful save by call <=20 after a substantive workbook edit, judged from full transcript and output snapshots; clean counts as provisional save but no contact

censoring.VALID_SUBMISSION: submit tool called with output workbook present
censoring.MODEL_NONCOMPLETION: call cap, cost cap, no save, clean save, no contact, no submit, ordinary run-time cap without infrastructure fault
censoring.PROVIDER_CENSORED: provider API timeout/refusal/HTTP error after retries
censoring.RUNNER_CENSORED: runner crash or global spend cap
censoring.WORKBOOK_INFRA_CENSORED: UNO calculation or official scorer infrastructure failure preventing assessment

replacement_rule: at most one R1 for each arm/task iff primary is PROVIDER_CENSORED, RUNNER_CENSORED, or WORKBOOK_INFRA_CENSORED; do not replace model outcomes, missing contact, score, or nonuse; primary and R1 kept separately
stopping_rule: exactly four frozen pairs in order plus permitted infrastructure R1 attempts; no interim adaptation, no enlargement, no automatic capability rerun or confirmation

decision_rule.PROBE_INCONCLUSIVE: infrastructure censoring after permitted replacements leaves timely-contact gate indeterminate (lower bound <3 and upper bound >=3); also if no valid assessment of actionability despite >=3 timely contacts because required trajectories are infra-lost
decision_rule.DELIVERY_TIMING_NOT_SUPPORTED: maximum possible timely contacts <3, or observed timely contacts <3 with all four treatment tasks classifiable
decision_rule.DELIVERY_SUPPORTED_ACTIONABILITY_WEAK: at least three timely contacts but fewer than two distinct timely trajectories with TRACEABLE_EVIDENCE_USE
decision_rule.DELIVERY_TIMING_SUPPORTED: at least three timely contacts and at least two distinct timely trajectories with TRACEABLE_EVIDENCE_USE

post_probe: freeze results; no original rerun, reserve opening, report redesign, new trigger, or larger benchmark
